decisive_items: M. pneumoniae-IgM titer: 1:320, later increased to >1:1280
PCR positive for M. pneumoniae in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid
response.rationale: Confirmed M. pneumoniae infection by IgM seroconversion and BAL PCR; severe pneumonia and plastic bronchitis are complications, while coronary dilation alone is insufficient for Kawasaki disease without clinical criteria.

rejected.why: Coronary artery dilation and recurrent fever are suggestive of Kawasaki disease, but the absence of mucocutaneous/clinical criteria and the confirmed M. pneumoniae pneumonia make it less likely than the primary infection.
